title: Render a List from Data
prompt:
Given `const todos = ["learn the DOM", "build a list", "render from data"]` and the `#todo-list` element: create one `li` per todo (with `createElement` + `textContent`), and append each to the list.

Rules:
- Loop or forEach over the array.
- Every li's text comes from the data.

tests.name: creates list items
tests.hint: const li = document.createElement("li"); inside your loop.

tests.name: text comes from the data
tests.code: if (!/\.textContent\s*=/.test(code)) throw new Error("Set each li's textContent from the todo.");
tests.hint: li.textContent = todo; — the loop variable carries the data.

tests.name: items appended to the list
tests.hint: list.appendChild(li) attaches the new element to the page.
